name: hover-magnify-dock
title: Hover Magnify Dock
description: An icon tray shelf computing Gaussian proximity curves to smoothly enlarge icons surrounding mouse pointer.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Gaussian Dock Magnification: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
